item_3_pricing.heading: Achology Pricing: Commonly Asked Questions
item_3_pricing.line: The questions people ask before they pay: what it costs, how to pay and what happens if you change your mind.
item_3_pricing.line_note: Replaces the earlier Pricing line, since the block now also covers paying and cancelling. Code measures it at 1280, 768 and 390 as before and reports any row problem; Code changes none of it.

questions.title: How much does Achology cost?
questions.short_answer: Courses run $97 to $299, school bundles $987 to $1,337, and the Access All Areas Pass is $2,995.

questions.title: Is Achology worth the money?
questions.short_answer: Worth it for practical, community-based learning; not for passive content or quick credentials.

questions.title: Does Achology offer discounts, sales, or promotional offers?
questions.short_answer: The discounts are permanent: bundles save 21 to 26 percent and the Pass saves 43 percent.

questions.title: Does Achology offer a free trial or introductory rate?
questions.short_answer: Yes, there is a free membership tier plus a $7 first month of full Achology Membership.

questions.title: What payment methods does Achology accept?
questions.short_answer: Stripe processes checkout; major credit and debit cards are accepted, with all prices in US dollars.

questions.title: Can I pay for Achology courses in instalments?
questions.short_answer: Yes: you can pay in full or spread the cost over monthly instalments, and the checkout shows the options for each course, bundle and pass.

questions.title: Are there hidden fees or additional costs at Achology?
questions.short_answer: No: the checkout price is final, but included membership continues at $34.50 monthly unless cancelled.

questions.title: How do monthly and annual Achology memberships differ?
questions.short_answer: Monthly is paid month by month after your first 30 days. Annual is paid once a year, saves $69 and includes every workbook and a masterclass for life.
questions.short_answer_source: the page excerpt already carried for 10041 in WORDS__Question_Block_Groups_And_Lines_Site_Wide_20Nov (Membership's signed one); the post itself has no excerpt yet, so pass this as the page's own excerpt for that id

questions.title: What is Achology's refund policy?
questions.short_answer: Courses, bundles, and the Pass carry a 14-day guarantee; membership is non-refundable once started.

questions.title: Does Achology offer a money-back guarantee?
questions.short_answer: Yes, a full 14-day guarantee covers courses, bundles, and the Pass; membership is the exception.

questions.title: How do I request a refund from Achology?
questions.short_answer: Email support@achology.com with your order number, purchase date, product name, and account email.

questions.title: Can I cancel my Achology membership anytime?
questions.short_answer: Yes, cancel in your billing settings anytime; access runs to the end of the paid period.
